headline: Google to retire Nest app and Google Assistant on smart speakers in 2027
summary: Google is shutting down the Nest app in favor of the Google Home app and retiring Google Assistant from smart speakers and displays. The Nest app shutdown is scheduled for January 25th, 2027, and outlets are advising users on how to transfer or save their data before then.
